class.description: SemanticFrameResource FrameNet / PropBank / VerbNet Predicate-Argument Frame Resource . Models an event or relation schema (`frame_name`, evoking verb/noun `lexical_units`, and selectional restrictions on `Agent`/`ARG0`, `Patient`/`ARG1`, and `Instrument`/`ARG2`). Part of IdeamLinguistics (phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantic lexicons).
